events.text: The French National Convention abolishes the monarchy.
The New York Sun publishes "Yes, Virginia, there is a Santa Claus".
J. R. R. Tolkien's The Hobbit is published.
Malta gains independence from the United Kingdom.
Belize gains independence from the United Kingdom.
Hurricane Hugo makes landfall in South Carolina.
Armenia declares independence from the Soviet Union.
The Chi-Chi earthquake kills more than 2,400 people in Taiwan.
NASA's Galileo spacecraft ends its mission by plunging into Jupiter.

births.text: H. G. Wells, English science-fiction author
